ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces, about 1.5-2 cm, cream-white with golden-brown seared edges and browned crust on some faces, firm, slightly moist surface, piled in the center of the bowl | 210
ITEM 2 | Sliced avocado, pale green flesh with slightly darker green skin edges, glossy and smooth, fanned slices about 0.5 cm thick scattered across the upper right and center | 130
ITEM 3 | Mixed salad greens, dark green leafy spinach-like and arugula-like leaves, matte, some wilted, spread across the bottom layer of the bowl under the other items | 60
ITEM 4 | Broccoli florets, dark green, small bite-sized clusters about 2 cm across, firm and slightly rough surface, scattered near the top left of the bowl | 30
ITEM 5 | Shredded carrot, bright orange thin strands, matte and slightly moist, mounded on the left side of a separate white plate | 45
ITEM 6 | Flaked tan-grey mixture, finely shredded and crumbly, slightly moist with small green flecks, sitting in a small heap on the left edge of the separate white plate | 40
